title: Fix Vercel build: prebuild workspace packages before Next.js
body:
Vercel build fails with `Module not found: Can't resolve '@object-ui/components'` (and core, react) because workspace packages export from `dist/` which doesn't exist until built. Vercel runs `pnpm build` in the site directory, which only executes `next build`, skipping package compilation.

## Changes

- **apps/site/package.json**: Added `prebuild` script to build workspace dependencies before Next.js build
  ```json
  "prebuild": "pnpm --filter @object-ui/types --filter @object-ui/core --filter @object-ui/react --filter @object-ui/components build"
  ```

- **docs/components/form/slider.mdx**: Fixed `defaultValue` from number to array (matches TypeScript interface, unblocks build)
  ```diff
  - defaultValue: 50
  + defaultValue: [50]
  ```

npm lifecycle hooks ensure `prebuild` runs before `build` automatically.
